projects/interface-intersignal.title: InterFace InterSignal
projects/interface-intersignal.content:
workshop
Explore the InterFace InterSignal workshop
Ina co-hosted a hands-on workshop exploring what happens when brain sensing becomes an accessible, everyday technology. Participants began not with terminology, but with live, unlabeled visualizations and interface elements, observing, describing, and speculating about what the signals might represent. The workshop then unpacked how raw electrical activity becomes processed data, contrasting ready-made scores with raw and processed EEG to examine how different forms of processing shape what we think the signal means. In small groups, participants creatively reconfigured a modifiable interface to observe the same signals differently and develop new creative interpretations, interfaces, or everyday uses, then invited participants to reconsider how brain signals might become material for curiosity and creative experimentation.

projects/somatic-synthesis.title: Somatic Synthesis
projects/somatic-synthesis.content:
data-visualization
Context: In clinical medicine, physiology is justifiably divided into specialties (cardiology, neurology, endocrinology) and wearable devices similarly present heart rate, respiration, stress, and sleep as separate dashboards and tabs. However, lived experience does not occur separately. Stress, calmness, and emotion are whole-body states borne from interactions between multiple physiological systems. This project explores how biosignals might be represented as an interconnected symbiotic system.

(Ryoji Ikeda exhibition I was inspired by.)

index.title: Ina Youn
index.content:
Hi, welcome. My name is Ina and I spend my time building, crafting, and thinking.
Selected projects

InterFace InterSignal — A hands-on workshop exploring brain sensing through live EEG visualizations and creative interface experiments.
Somatic Synthesis — An exploration of how biosignals can represent the interactions between physiological systems.
